findings.detail: `if (identifierKey(val)) rawMaterialsSet.add(identifierKey(val));` runs the Unicode `\p{M}\p{Cf}` regex replace twice for the same value, at line 404 and again at line 423. Line 423 sits in the `rawSkuCol === -1` fallback, which iterates *every cell of every Raw row*, so on a large Raw sheet this doubles the normalisation work on the hottest loop in the validate pass. No correctness impact and the loop is already chunked, so this is cleanup rather than a user-visible problem.
findings.summary: identifierKey(val) computed twice per cell when building the membership set

findings.detail: `margin = retailPrice > 0 ? marginOf(...) : null` blanks Margin when Retail Price is 0, but `note` is only populated when `profit === null` (line 313). With Retail Price 0 and a known cost, Profit *is* known, so the Note is `''` and the Profit Analysis row ships a blank Margin% cell with no reason — exactly the gap the Note was added to close, and what MODULE_GUIDE.md promises ("why Profit and Margin are blank whenever they are"). A free/placeholder-priced composite with cost 0 is the clean case: break-even, blank Margin, empty Note, and no `Cost is higher than Retail Price` error either, so nothing anywhere explains the blank. Narrow trigger (Retail Price must parse to exactly 0), hence low; it would be medium if Margin were silently wrong rather than silently blank.
findings.summary: Retail Price of exactly 0 leaves Margin blank with no Note explaining it

findings.detail: `COMPOSITE.map((r) => r.map(String)).map((r) => r.map((c) => c))` — the second `.map` is an identity transform that does nothing. It reads as if a conversion were intended and was dropped, which is the kind of leftover that makes the next reader of this assertion pause and re-derive what the expected grid actually is.
findings.summary: Redundant identity `.map((c) => c)` in the hidden-rows/columns assertion
